Especially this Motocross GP commentator, Some guy who seems to be named Calvin/Kelvin.. not sure as he doesn't even announce his name. At this racing season of 2026. He's like the Murray Walker of motorcycle commentators, with all the mistakes he makes on riders and situations. Probably because he wants to mention where each rider comes from. We just need to know the names of the riders, his position during the race. Not his country of birth or place of birth and nationality. Which can be considered racial discrimination even!
 
It's a pity to have to mention and criticise commentators for the sake of being able to give an honest opinion on experiences using an app and it's service, for MXGP. 

Although only'Lisa Layland' is on the ball and pleasant speaking to riders and team management however.

reviews.title: I have renewed my subscription but Discovery+ want me to do it again.
reviews.text:
It was about an hour ago that I renewed my subscription.  It had been cancelled by Amazon without me asking for it to be cancelled.  I tried all ways to resubscibe, but there was no way of doing that on Amazon.  I made a complaint to Amazon, and added a one star review on Trust Pilot.  It was soon after that that Discovery+ contacted me via email and TNT Sports, to resubscribe.  I did so, or so I thought.  Because I am being asked to re-subscribe again.  I am very wary of doing this, as from other instances of doing it with other companies, I found myself with two subscriptions for the same thing - and money taken out of my bank account twice.
So at this moment in time, I’m going to stay put, and add another I’ve been treated by one star review on Trust Pilot.  It really doesn’t bother me one way or the other whether I add one star reviews or 5 star reviews.  I have posted more than 50 reviews of companies which have given me good and bad treatment.  I just reflect how I have been treated.  So if Discovery+ wishes me to add a few more stars to my review of them, then they had better treat me that way.  Starting with sorting out this mess which they have created.

reviews.title: £30 to watch ads
reviews.text:
Bought the pass so I can watch the AO, only to find out that they shoehorn ads in whenever there’s a switch over. Worst yet is that the ads run for a set time, and it doesn’t mean that they’ll end by the time the next game starts, so often a point starts and you’re stuck watching ads. Even worse is that in lots of cases you don’t get to watch a point replay, but you get a quick ad instead. It’s beyond a joke, not happy at all.

The app itself had improved a bit since last year, but it can still be a chore to find the sport you want to watch. I’d like the option to favourite a sport, and have it show at the top of the screen, even when it’s not live, rather than going though categories and flicking through numerous screens

reviews.title: Worst of all the streaming apps
reviews.text: I have a lot of streaming apps, primarily for sport but also for entertainment. Discovery+ is the worst of them. It should be called Discovery-. I can watch something one day, continue the app the next day and it won’t log me in. Many resets and tries later I get in. If I try to resume watching a program it often restarts it from the beginning. As for live streaming, it often buffers. I have other apps that occasionally buffer but Discovery is the worst. What am I paying for? May be I won’t much longer and just forgo the sport I love
